doc: Coverage anomaly of decision record 3: 0.25 tanh(w / 0.05 m/s) for the uplift, w = u dh/dx + v dh/dy from centered differences (wrap in longitude, dx = 2 pi R / w max(cos lat, 1e-3), dh/dy zero at the two pole rows), minus 0.2 x the rain shadow: the strongest uplift sampled 0.15, 0.35, 0.6 and 1.0 x 800 km upwind weighted by (1 - 0.5 frac) and by smoothstep(0.2, 1.0 km) of the descent from the upwind ground, times (1 - the local uplift). Only the elevation of the surface is read (a surface of another width than the wind is resampled by `at` first). Tolerance: the field is float64 sampling of float32 arrays and a tanh of slope 20 per m/s; measured worst difference 4.7e-8 against an all-float64 evaluation and 1.9e-7 when the elevation and the wind move by one float32 ulp: atol 2e-6, rtol 1e-5 (10x). The 64x32 world with a uniform 10 m/s EASTERLY (retrograde-like): uplift on the east slope, shadow to the WEST (u < 0 flips the sign of lo - d u / speed / cos). params.constants lists the module constants and the inline numbers the function reads (a port copies them from its own source and may assert that they equal these).
